verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no vendor documentation of pricing plans, cost caps, or predictable scaling, so there is no first-party claim that costs stay predictable. Community reports point the opposite way. One user calls the price-per-search model ridiculous for live-search UIs. Another switched away because large indexes are too expensive. A third notes that sort replicas multiplied 30K records into 150K and blew past record limits. These match the per-request and per-record cliffs the story wants to avoid.
